set.body: Create the first immutable repository baseline for the audited untracked implementation and record the audit snapshot. Amend the package and execution designs to fix the effect-space, feature-domain, memory-budget, BLAS-observation, source-lifecycle, neuroim2-boundary, and public-API decisions before code depends on them. Done when the baseline is reproducible and every later child has an unambiguous written contract.
set.title: Freeze remediation contracts and establish a reproducible baseline
